prompt: Create an original 90 second acoustic swing jazz instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: acoustic guitar, violin, upright bass. Style: crisp rhythmic guitar and playful violin phrases. Tempo approximately 148 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A lively and intricate folk-inspired piece featuring a prominent accordion and a string ensemble, creating a vibrant and energetic atmosphere.
